violations.title: Cover Foods in Storage
violations.observation: Unwrapped or uncovered food in the following location where the food is subject to contamination: Walk-in refrigerator.
violations.corrective_action: Foods shall be protected from contamination by being stored in packages, covered containers or wrappings unless being cooled. Corrected during the inspection.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: sauces, oils, other liquids in unmarked squeeze bottles and containers.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Insect Control Devices, Installation
violations.observation: Insect control devices are located over food preparation station, and dish washing area, where dead insects may be impelled or fall. Observed fly tapes hanging above prep table, 3-compartment sink, dish washing areas.
violations.corrective_action: Relocate the insect control device so that it is not located over a food preparation area and dead insects are prevented from being falling on exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service and single-use articles. Remove these tapes carefully, from these areas.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. Food containers were noted stored on the floor inside the walk-in refrigerator and freezer and in the dry storage areas.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter and food preparation tables.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses.

violations.title: In-Use Utensils Proper Storage
violations.observation: Dispensing and/or in-use utensils improperly stored between use as follows: Knives of different shapes and sizes were found stored in-between tables and walls.
violations.corrective_action: During pauses in food preparation or dispensing, food utensils shall be stored in one of the following manners: 1) in the food with their handles above the top of the food and the container, 2) in food that is not time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food with their handles above the top of the food within containers or equipment that can be closed, 3) on a clean portion of the food preparation table or cooking equipment only if the in-use utensil and the food contact surface of the food preparation table or cooking equipment are cleaned and sanitized, 4) in running water of sufficient velocity to flush particulates to the drain, 5) in a clean, protected location if the utensils are used only with a food that is NOT TCS food, or 6) in a container of water if the water is maintained at a temperature of at least 135F and the container is cleaned frequently. LOTUS GARDEN (Inspection Date: 05/06/2026) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Cleaning Frequency
violations.observation: Observed that the storage shelving inside the walk-in Refrigerator, were noted to be rusty and covered with debris. The grease filters under the hood system are in need of cleaning.
violations.corrective_action: Clean the physical facilities at a frequency necessary to ensure the protection and safe preparation of food.Properly clean these shelves to remove the rust band buildup-up debris. Clean the grease filters .

violations.title: Premises Free of Unnecessary Items/Equipment
violations.observation: Observed that items that are unnecessary to the operation or maintenance of the establishment are being stored on the premises.
violations.corrective_action: Remove unnecessary items, including equipment which is no longer in use, from the premises to allow for regular and effective cleaning and to prevent harborage conditions.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: Observed the food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. CDI: EHS emailed CFM written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events.

violations.title: Where to Wash
violations.observation: Observed a food employee was observed cleaning their hands in 3 compartment sink.
violations.corrective_action: ALL food employees shall wash their hands in ONLY a designated handsink. CDI: CFM instructed food employee to wash hands at designated hand sink in kitchen area. LOTUS GARDEN (Inspection Date: 11/12/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Access to Handwashing Sink
violations.observation: Observed the handwashing facility located at the back and front of the kitchen area is blocked by kitchen equipment and utensils stored in the sink basin, preventing access by employees for easy handwashing.
violations.corrective_action: A hand washing sink shall be maintained so that it is accessible at all times for employee use. CDI: CFM removed equipment and utensils from sink basin.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw shelled eggs and uncooked squid stored above cooked white rice in the walk in refrigerator, raw shelled cracked egg in bowl (uncovered) stored above RTE diced onions inside the top part of the Duker 2 Dr undercounter refrigerator in kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: CFM relocated cooked white rice to top shelf inside the walk in refrigerator. CFM relocated bowl of cracked shelled eggs to bottom shelf inside the Dukers 2 Dr undercounter refrigerator.

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: bowl of uncooked chicken (ambient temperature 48F) on prep counter at room temp (not actively being prepped during time of inspection), precooked commercially prepared shrimp tempura (50F) in container stored on food prep counter at room temperature at time of inspection.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: CFM placed uncooked chicken and shrimp tempura back in walk in refrigerator to cool until prepared/ cooked.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Observed boxes of food stored on the floor (less than 6 inches off the floor) inside the walk in freezer.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. CDI: CFM relocated boxes of food to shelf inside the walk in freezer.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Food-Contact Surfaces, Corrosion-Resistant/Nonabsorbent Materials
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment and/or utensils are not durable: recently fried chicken cooling in cardboard box on food prep counter in the kitchen area.
violations.corrective_action: Materials that are used in the construction of utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment may not allow the migration of deleterious substances or impart colors, odors, or tastes to food and under normal use conditions shall be durable, corrosion-resistant, and nonabsorbent. CDI: Food prep employee transferred fried chicken to food safe sheet pan to properly cool.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. Observed no written procedure for clean up of vomit or diarrhea.
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided written procedure for CFM.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: RAW SHRIMP OVER CABBAGE IN #3.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CFM MOVED RAW FOOD TO BOTTOM SHELF.

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: OBSERVED CLEAN STRAINER STORED ABOVE BACK HAND SINK WITH FOOD DEBRIS IN MESH.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CFM discarded strainer.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. CFM could not produce a thermometer for the monitoring of foods.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. CFM will purchase thermometer and provide proof to EHS within 10 days.

violations.title: Thermometers, Location for Units with TCS foods
violations.observation: There was no temperature measuring device located in the following cold or hot holding equipment: 2 DR UC #1, WIC #4.
violations.corrective_action: Cold or hot holding equipment used for the storage of time/temperature control for safety food shall be designed to include and shall be equipped with at least one integral or permanently affixed temperature measuring device that is located to allow easy viewing of the device's temperature display. CFM will purchase thermometer for units.

violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: observed containers of spices, starches and squeeze bottles of oil, water, sauces throughout kitchen.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. CFM will have employees relabel containers.
